observations.body: Paul says God’s righteousness is revealed through faith in Jesus Christ, all have sinned, and God presents Christ through his blood to demonstrate righteousness.
observations.label: God presents Christ as an atoning sacrifice

observations.body: The passage presents universal sin, gift, redemption, blood, divine forbearance, justice, and faith as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: universal sin, gift, redemption, blood, divine forbearance, justice, and faith

observations.body: The passage places atoning presentation beside universal sin, gift, redemption, blood, divine forbearance, justice, and faith.
observations.label: atoning presentation

payload.posture: Read Romans 3:21–26 as evidence about sacrifice, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: the dense argument combines law-court, redemption, and sacrificial language without reducing them to one metaphor
payload.title: God presents Christ as an atoning sacrifice
